## Overview

A side-anchored modal. It is a [`DialogService`](/docs/reference/api/primitives/dialog-service) dialog — same focus trap, focus
restoration, background inertness, scroll lock and Escape/backdrop dismissal — anchored to
an edge, with exit presence on by default. Consumers own width, height and appearance.

The panel carries `data-qz-drawer`, `data-side` (physical edge) and `data-state`
(`opening` | `open` | `closing`). Style `[data-state='closing']` for the exit transition.

- **Kind:** Service
- **Provided in:** `root`
- **Source:** [packages/primitives/src/drawer/drawer.service.ts:28](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/drawer/drawer.service.ts#L28)
